newsitem.title: UK: British Airways down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: British Airways down on profit taking.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc fell around 1.6 percent, or 12p, to 713-1/2 on Tuesday by midday in volume of over 2.3 million shares as investors locked in some profits after a recent good run, dealers said.
"I think its mostly profit-taking", one trader said, adding that British Airways had shown a good performance in recent months.
BA shares, which hit a 1997 peak of 769-3/4p in mid-May, have risen by 23 percent over the past six months, according to data from Reuters Securities 3000.

BA on Tuesday routinely declined to comment on media reports it would take over the independent Italian airline Air One. Earlier this weak the London newspaper The Independent reported that BA was in advanced talk with Air One, which were at an advanced stage.
